newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Liberty Life says Q1 new business up 65 pct.
newsitem.headline: Liberty Life says Q1 new business up 65 pct.

text.p: Liberty Life Association of Africa Ltd said on Wednesday that its new financial year had got off to a good start with new business figures for the first quarter of 1997 more than 65 percent up on the year-ago level.
Chairman Donald Gordon told the annual meeting that new business had got off to a slow start in 1996 but despite this the results for the current year were "most gratifying".
Recurring premium business was 25 percent up on the 1996 comparative level.
The company said the introduction of new technology for use by sales intermediaries was clearly having an impact.
